issues.title: EOS-007 — Governance Repository Persistence
issues.body:
## Source
DPP-2026-08-06-EOS-V1-FOUNDATION — APPROVED — 2026-08-06 — Approved by Owner

## Queue Identity
- Issue ID: EOS-007
- Queue Status: READY
- Order: 1

## Capability
- EOS-002
- EOS-015

## Objective
Persist the approved EOS v1.0 governance foundation as traceable repository state rather than local-only untracked assets.

## Dependencies
- None

## Scope
- Inspect all current governance assets and their Git state
- Confirm governance-file identity and GIA domain mapping before persistence
- Establish traceable GitHub repository persistence for the approved governance foundation
- Return persistence evidence without beginning product development

## Out of Scope
- PVOS product feature or product-code changes
- Blueprint content changes
- Operating Cycle changes
- Workspace restructuring or new repository creation
- Execution of EOS-008 or later queue items

## Deliverables
- Governance asset inventory and persistence record
- Repository-state evidence for the governance foundation
- Updated governance-file traceability where required

## Acceptance Criteria
- Approved governance assets are no longer dependent on local-only untracked state
- Repository persistence is traceable to this GitHub Issue
- No product, Blueprint, Operating Cycle, or Workspace scope is changed
- Final executor state is READY_FOR_PM_REVIEW unless a stop condition occurs

## Required Evidence
- Existing Asset Inspection Report
- Governance files persisted or changed
- Verification results
- Git and GitHub repository state
- Known risks or explicit Blocked, Rejected, or Governance Conflict condition

## Execution Control
This GitHub Issue is the sole Execution Source for Codex. Stop at `READY_FOR_PM_REVIEW`; PM owns review and closing.

issues.body:
## Source

## Queue Identity

- Queue Status: READY
- Order: 9

## Capability
- EOS-015

## Objective
Perform the final EOS v1.0 capability audit across EOS-001 through EOS-016 and determine evidence-based readiness for PM Review.

## Dependencies
- EOS-014 — #43

## Scope
- Audit all sixteen Capability definitions, implementations, dependencies, governance documents, repository persistence, and work-item coverage
- Verify the complete flow from Planning Package through GitHub Issue, Codex, Evidence, and PM Review
- Classify every Capability as Not Started, In Progress, Completed, or Verified using durable evidence
- Report all gaps, dependency conflicts, and stop conditions without self-approving EOS completion

## Out of Scope
- Fixing audit findings without a separate authorized Issue
- Declaring PM Review, Owner Review, or Daily Governed Closing complete
- Product, Blueprint, Operating Cycle, Workspace, or repository architecture changes

## Deliverables
- Final EOS v1.0 Capability Audit
- Capability coverage and status matrix
- Dependency and governance-consistency results
- PM Review readiness recommendation and known risks

## Acceptance Criteria
- EOS-001 through EOS-016 are individually assessed against repository evidence
- No capability is marked Verified without PM evidence
- Every unresolved gap is explicit and traceable
- Result stops at READY_FOR_PM_REVIEW, Blocked, Rejected, or Governance Conflict

## Required Evidence
- Existing Asset Inspection Report
- Sixteen-capability audit table
- Dependency and governance-flow verification
- Git and GitHub repository state
